en: Have employee complete self evaluation on page 1.
Supervisor completes evaluation and makes notes on page 1 and page 2.
Supervisor and employee meet to discuss review.
Employee may make comments if desired on page 2 at end of meeting.
Both supervisor and employee sign, date, and return it to the office.
